event: Transient increase in repaired and repeated frames around 09:30–10:20 of the recording.

visual_samples.monitor-590.png: Movie picture and subtitles remain visible, with horizontal noise/distortion particularly across the lower picture.
visual_samples.monitor-620.png: Movie picture present without the pronounced horizontal disruption in the earlier sample.

cause: Not established; do not attribute exclusively to tape condition or capture hardware without further evidence.
action: Capture left running unchanged. Counters stabilized after the event. Include this event in the final findings and select speech references before and after it to check for a possible synchronization step as well as drift.
kernel_evidence: STK1160 offset-out-of-bounds messages and a warning in stk1160_process_isoc coincide with the disturbance; see kernel-event.log. Underlying cause is not established.
